attackers_goals: Clone existing compute volumes for exfiltration purposes. This action may be a preliminary action before downloading snapshot blocks or creating volumes from the snapshots.
description: One or more EBS snapshots were created from an EC2 instance.
investigative_actions: Confirm that the identity intended to create the described snapshots. Monitor the source instance for additional suspicious activities. Follow further actions done by the identity.
